scenarios.name: Navigate adjacent part templates with arrow keys

background_steps.name: a fresh MCAD Software session loads `fixtures/cad/document-creation-navigation-candidate.opj` as its active project
its Metric folder contains exactly the four named native part templates used below
its English folder contains the standard inch part template

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is active with `Sketch1` visible in the MCAD Software
the new-document chooser shows the metric folder grouped by type using Medium icons
the part group displays Sheet Metal (mm) immediately before Standard (DIN)
the user selects the Sheet Metal (mm) part template
its tile is selected and its details identify millimeter units
the Standard (DIN) part tile is selected
the details identify Standard (DIN) and millimeter units
the Sheet Metal (mm) part tile is selected again
Sheet Metal (mm) remains selected with its details displayed
the chooser closes and the original part remains active
